intro: Financial services and government organizations were the most frequently targeted sectors across 65 phishing articles published between 2026-04-08 and 2026-09-30. Coverage spans Global, United states, Latin america, Canada, and Russia, with 57 high-severity and 8 medium-severity incidents. Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit feature among the tracked threat actors. Frequently cited vulnerabilities include CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. Cryptocurrency, hospitality, and technology round out the affected sectors documented in this archive.
